Airport lounge guest policies differ significantly based on lounge type and how access is obtained, such as through loyalty status, memberships or select travel cards.
Most lounges allow complimentary entry for children under 2, but fees for additional guests can be substantial and vary by lounge network.
Some programs offer complimentary or discounted guest access if you meet high annual spending thresholds, while others charge per guest regardless of spend.
Understanding each lounge's guest policy is crucial to avoid unexpected costs, especially when traveling with family or groups.
Guest limits, age restrictions and per-visit fees for additional guests can change frequently and may depend on your access method.
Certain lounges require all guests to be traveling on the same flight, and some restrict guest access during periods of high crowding.
Premium lounges, such as those for international first or business class, often have stricter guest policies or exclude guests entirely.
